title: Bitcoin’s $60,000 breakdown puts December Fed decision under the spotlight
summary: Bitcoin fell below $60,000 on Friday for the first time since July, with US spot Bitcoin funds recording withdrawals and short-term Treasury bills offering investors more than 4% a year.
